newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: SOCCER-PSV OUTCLASS AJAX, STAY TOP.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-PSV OUTCLASS AJAX, STAY TOP.

text.p: Wim Jonk and Luc Nilis hit the goals as PSV Eindhoven humiliated Ajax 2-0 in Amsterdam on Sunday. The victory kept PSV top, three points ahead of Feyenoord, heading into the Dutch winter break.
Jonk opened the scoring just before halftime and leading marksman Luc Nilis doubled the tally with his 15th goal of the season in the dying seconds.
Injury-hit Ajax forced coach Louis van Gaal to bring in defender Kofi Mensah, the 28th player he has used this season, although strikers Patrick Kluivert and Jari Litmanen were in the line-up.
PSV gradually took control and in the 28th minute they went close to scoring when Marc Overmars cleared a Philip Cocu header off the line.
Two minutes before the break former Ajax midfielder Jonk drove home a Nilis cross from the left.
Ajax's injury jinx struck again 10 minutes into the second half when Mario Melchiot went off.
Brazilian Marcio Santos replaced him but was sent off a minute later after a professional foul on Nilis.
Zeljko Petrovic hit the inside of both posts for PSV only to have the ball finish at the feet of Marciano Vink via his arm. The goal was disallowed.
Feyenoord remained well in the hunt with a 2-1 victory at NEC Nijmegen. Gaston Taument hit both goals.
Taument was on target in the 38th minute when he took advantage of a defensive blunder by Marcel Koning.
Maurice Graef equalised in the 72nd minute but Taument was on hand for the late winner.
PSV have 48 points from 20 matches, followed by Feyenoord with 45. Ajax trail seventh, 18 points behind the leaders.
